purpose: Record source-confirmed inlet geometry and the remaining boundary-condition gaps for the Dickens Type-III tank diagnostic.

source.source_geometry_statement: The published experiment describes a Type-III tank with 0.358 m internal diameter and a 5 mm internal-diameter stainless-steel inlet pipe extending 0.082 m into the tank.
source.source_geometry_scope: The 5 mm inlet value is source-confirmed for the Dickens experiment; it is not inferred from the simulator outcome.

tank_internal_length_m.note: The source paper reports the inner tank length as 0.893 m, while the archived HydDown case uses 0.7451 m to reproduce the 74 L case volume. The two values must not be silently merged.

inlet_pipe_internal_diameter_m.note: The existing post-outcome 5 mm sensitivity run is physically supported by the published inlet-pipe description, but the frozen case did not declare this value.

boundary_mapping.remaining_boundary_gap: A new prospective run needs the time-resolved inlet hydrogen temperature and an explicitly frozen inlet geometry mapping.

diagnostic_interpretation.why_not_retroactive: The inlet diameter was confirmed after the negative frozen outcome and after the sensitivity was inspected. It can explain and prioritize a new prospective test, but cannot convert a post-outcome sensitivity into confirmatory validation.

claim_boundary: This mapping supports a source-grounded follow-up protocol for one Type-III tank-filling component. It does not validate the HRS cascade, compressor, precooler, dispenser metering, vehicle receptacle, consequence distances, safety logic or SAGA effectiveness.
